en.body:
When a spike in user traffic caused a 30‑second latency breach in our real‑time recommendation service, scaling Kafka Streams state stores cut latency to under 200 ms and saved $120k monthly on infra.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Read the full article on the site, then open GitHub for operational proof.
